basic_info.description: A stylishly updated SFH with views, perched on a quiet Glen Park hillside. Spanning 2 lvls, this home features an open, light-filled layout, energy-efficient solar upgrades, and exceptional indoor-outdoor flow. Upstairs, the remodeled kitchen stuns w/ a skylight, warm-toned cabinets, matte black hardware, and premium appliances incl. Wolf range, Liebherr fridge & Thermador DW. Sunny dining area and SE-facing deckideal for morning coffee or al fresco dinners. A WB fireplace, floating shelves, dual-pane windows, recessed lights & parquet flrs add warmth. All 3 BRs are on one lvl, generously sized, and the remodeled BAs includes designer tile, skylight & new vanity. The lower-lvl den has a wet bar, media niche, and opens to a terraced yard w/ lounge & dining decks + garden-ready upper terrace. Tesla solar (6.12kW), Powerwall 2 (13.5kWh), EV charger, Air Con!, upgraded elec/plumbing, new stucco, and 2-car SxS garage round out the home. Just mins to BART, Glen Park Village, Glen Canyon Park & Rec., & top schoolsthis is sustainable, sunlit city living at its best.
